result.summary: Found TC-OBS-05-INT-01 and TC-OBS-06-INT-05 already passing on current main (prior queue-drain work resolved them). TC-OBS-05-INT-02/03 still failed. Diagnosed 4 layered defects via added narrow build steps (test-integration-obs05/-obs06) with -Dlog-pg-errors=true: (1) stale ::uuid cast on audit_entries.resource_id (TEXT since GBL-120/ISS-103) in the test file itself, same class as ISS-0637/ISS-0638; (2) once fixed, exposed that tenant_default's copies of bpm_audit_resource_info/bpm_audit_action_for_change were never updated by GBL-121 (GBL-prefixed migrations are public-only, but audit_entries/dead_letter_items are PER_TENANT tables living in tenant_default) so the audit trigger silently skipped every dlq.retry/dlq.discard INSERT; (3) fixing (2) via a new migration exposed that tests/integration/helpers.zig's runMigrationsForSchema() fast path only checked one hardcoded historical migration version as a staleness proxy, so the long-lived bpm_test container's tenant_default schema never received the new migration; (4) fixing (3) let test execution reach a previously-unreached SAVEPOINT call on a connection never inside a transaction (C25P01), and a first attempt to fix that by wrapping in conn.begin()/rollback caused a genuine cross-connection self-deadlock (confirmed live via pg_stat_activity, resolved by pg_terminate_backend) because the deliberate CREATE TRIGGER needs to be committed for a second, separately-acquired pool connection to observe it.
